output: Five: social for conversation, go for Go concepts, gocode for writing Go code, gocli for Go terminal commands, and makefile for make commands. Each message is routed to the right brain.
I can chat, explain Go concepts, write Go code, turn plain English into go commands, and suggest make commands. Try asking me what a goroutine is, or have you ever played soccer.
I am a tiny one. A pure-Go seq2seq model with mixture-of-experts, trained from scratch on a small dataset. Small, but real.
make chat starts a unified chat session. Every message is routed to one of five brains: social, go, gocode, gocli, or makefile, and you can see which one answered by the tag.
make smarter is the one-command upgrade. It backs up the checkpoints, imports new training data through the quality gate, retrains the social and Go brains, runs the evals, and prints a report.
make eval scores every brain on its fixed eval suite, so you can see exactly what is working and what is not.
make sel opens a columnar fuzzy finder over the make commands. Type to filter, pick one with the arrow keys, and it runs.
make explain prints an overview of the Gollemer project and describes what each make command does.
make train-social retrains the social conversation brain on all the social training data, so it chats better.
make train-go retrains the Go concept brain, which answers questions about the Go language.
make train-gocode retrains the brain that writes Go code from your descriptions.
make train-gocli retrains the brain that turns plain English into exact go and gofmt terminal commands.
make train-makefile retrains the brain that maps your requests to make commands.
make import loads new training pairs from a JSONL file through the quality gate. Point it at your file with FILE=path.jsonl.
make help lists the available make commands with a one-line description of each.

New question-and-answer pairs go through a quality gate that checks coherence, then they are merged into the training data and the brains retrain on old plus new. Bad data gets quarantined, never trained on.
